name: Tablet of the Seven
summary: Maxwort Uberglint asks you to bring a tablet transcript to him in the Burning Steppes. The inscription calls for careful transcription.

sections.title: A tablet transcript
sections.body: Maxwort Uberglint is waiting in the Burning Steppes for the Tablet Transcript. You have found the tablet and made a transcription, and he praises your work. The transcript is what he asked you to bring.

faq.q: Who is waiting for the Tablet Transcript?
faq.answer: Maxwort Uberglint is waiting for the Tablet Transcript in the Burning Steppes.

faq.q: What does Maxwort ask me to bring?
faq.answer: Maxwort asks you to bring the Tablet Transcript.

faq.q: Where do I bring the Tablet Transcript?
faq.answer: Bring the Tablet Transcript to Maxwort Uberglint in the Burning Steppes.

attribution: In-game quest text: Tablet of the Seven
